title: AI Gameplan Week 4: Career Launch
tagline: Get the job. Turn the work into a portfolio, applications, outreach, and confidence.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Resume Rebuild
lessons.goal: Reagan builds three tailored resume versions for college athletics roles.
sections: List the work from Weeks 1 to 3 that belongs on a resume.
Write one master version with skills, projects, outcomes, and proof.
Create versions for operations, social and content, and admin or recruiting support.
Turn in all three resumes and explain what changed for each target.
lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for resume rebuild.

visuals.title: Resume proof stack
visuals.note: Resume bullets should come from real work she can defend.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: LinkedIn and Online Presence
lessons.goal: Reagan updates LinkedIn and creates a clean professional presence.
sections: Headline, about section, experience, education, skills, and featured work.
Position the course as proof she can learn fast, use AI responsibly, and produce sports work.
Write 3 connection messages for people in college athletics.
Turn in screenshots or draft copy for CJ review before publishing.
lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for linkedin and online presence.

visuals.title: LinkedIn proof
visuals.note: Keep it professional, specific, and true.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Target List and Research
lessons.goal: Reagan creates a target list of college athletics organizations and roles.
sections: Find 10 organizations, departments, or roles that fit the goal.
Record role, contact path, why it fits, recent news, and source link.
Turn in the target list and source log.
lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for target list and research.

visuals.title: Target research board
visuals.note: A good target list has reasons, not just names.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Game Day Ops Mock Project
lessons.goal: Reagan creates a game day operations plan to show sports admin thinking.
sections: Choose a sample football, flag football, or athletics event.
Build timeline, staffing, equipment, comms, risk plan, and fan experience notes.
Ask AI what is missing, then decide what to add.
Turn in a polished Game Day Operations Plan.

quiz.q: What does an ops plan need?

choices: She can think like a sports operator

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for game day ops mock project.

visuals.title: Game day plan
visuals.note: Operations is details, timing, roles, and calm execution.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: Job Search System
lessons.goal: Reagan builds a repeatable job search tracker and outreach workflow.
sections: Columns: organization, role, link, contact, status, next step, date, notes.
Create reusable but editable bullets for cover letters and messages.
Define when to search, apply, follow up, and update CJ.
Turn in tracker plus 5 tailored application targets.

quiz.q: What is the weekly rhythm for?

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for job search system.

visuals.title: Job search tracker
visuals.note: The system keeps the search moving when motivation dips.

lessons.title: Lesson 6: Portfolio and Final Presentation
lessons.goal: Reagan packages the course into a portfolio and presents it to CJ.
sections: Include best work from all 4 weeks with short explanations and proof links.
Explain what she learned, what she built, and how she will use it in college athletics.
Prepare a 10 minute presentation for CJ.
Turn in portfolio, Drive folder, presentation notes, and final closeout.

choices: Best work with proof and context
A portfolio and job search system she can use

lessons.checkpoint: I can show proof for portfolio and final presentation.

visuals.title: Final portfolio
visuals.note: Package the proof so an employer can understand it fast.

qualityRules: Resume and LinkedIn claims must be true and backed by proof.
Public profile changes need CJ review.
Every target needs a source and reason.
Final portfolio must be employer ready.
